title: Chapter 11
text: As dragons ferociously guard both their young and any information regarding their development, only four facts are known about the Dreamless Sleep. First, it is a critical time of rapid growth and development. Second, the duration varies from breed to breed. Third, as the name suggests, it is dreamless, and fourth, they wake up hungry. —C OLONEL K AORI’S F IELD G UIDE TO D RAGONKIND
